comments.comment: RE-SAN9PK-0111 [confirmed]: shared recruit-target predicate rejects own-side, same-leader and force-relation exclusions; automatic code-24 prefilters raw identities 4/5, so captured targets must be held by the acting side and identity-5 targets must be unassigned/recruitable.

RE-SAN9PK-0111 [confirmed]: automatic code-24 requires an available source, actors from own cities with raw identity mask 0x0F and current politics 35..115, and eligible targets from raw identity mask 0x30.
RE-SAN9PK-0111 [confirmed]: command dispatch reserves the actor, stores type 24 plus a stable actor-target rnd(100) payload, computes normal travel time, and marks the source task active.

RE-SAN9PK-0111 [confirmed]: advisor output compares two Bernoulli results made with the same stable seed—recruit threshold versus advisor judgment threshold—and reports agreement (1) or disagreement (3); it is not the command's final roll.

RE-SAN9PK-0111 [confirmed]: code-24 task phases 1000/1001/1002/1003 handle arrival, presentation, stored-random<threshold resolution, and final writeback. Success initializes identity 3, destination, per-force loyalty and possible leader-led object defection; failure preserves identity/force/location while only adjusting relations and per-force loyalty.

RE-SAN9PK-0111 [confirmed boundary]: search-person immediate recruitment shares the threshold but uses a fresh global-stream roll and distinct loyalty initialization; accepted failure exposes identity 5 at the found location and sets recruiting-force loyalty 49.

evidence_summary: Interactive and automatic code-24 producers converge on one command; dispatch fixes only a stable 0..99 payload, while phase 1002 recomputes the live threshold. Success initializes identity, destination and per-force loyalty with optional responsible-person object defection; failure preserves identity, force and location.
